title: Three questions in one message are answered one by one, from the menu only

turns.user: I want a table for four on Friday, do you have a high chair for a toddler, and is there a deposit?

model.text: Table for four: yes, just tell me the time and I'll hold it. High chair: we have one, I'll keep it at your table. Deposit: none for a normal table — nothing to pay to hold it.
